schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS digits (n TINYINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts (account_id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, active TINYINT NOT NULL, segment VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, created_at DATE NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wide_events (event_id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, account_id INT NOT NULL, wide_group_key VARCHAR(768) NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, event_date DATE NOT NULL, KEY idx_account_date (account_id, event_date), KEY idx_event_date (event_date))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS narrow_events (event_id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, account_id INT NOT NULL, narrow_group_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, payload VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, event_date DATE NOT NULL, KEY idx_account_date (account_id, event_date), KEY idx_event_date (event_date))
generation_sql: INSERT IGNORE INTO accounts (account_id, active, segment, created_at) SELECT a.n * 1000 + b.n * 100 + c.n * 10 + d.n + 1, IF(MOD(a.n * 1000 + b.n * 100 + c.n * 10 + d.n + 1, 5) = 0, 0, 1), CONCAT('seg_', MOD(a.n * 1000 + b.n * 100 + c.n * 10 + d.n + 1, 10)), DATE_ADD('2024-01-01', INTERVAL MOD(a.n * 1000 + b.n * 100 + c.n * 10 + d.n + 1, 365) DAY) FROM digits a CROSS JOIN digits b CROSS JOIN digits c CROSS JOIN digits d

INSERT IGNORE INTO wide_events (event_id, account_id, wide_group_key, payload, amount, event_date) SELECT seq.event_id, MOD(seq.event_id, 10000) + 1, CASE WHEN MOD(seq.event_id, 5) = 0 THEN RPAD('hot_group', 700, 'h') ELSE RPAD(CONCAT('grp_', LPAD(MOD(seq.event_id, 999), 6, '0')), 700, 'g') END, RPAD(CONCAT('payload_', LPAD(seq.event_id, 6, '0')), 1024, 'x'), MOD(seq.event_id, 1000) / 10.0, DATE_ADD('2024-01-01', INTERVAL MOD(seq.event_id, 365) DAY) FROM (SELECT a.n * 10000 + b.n * 1000 + c.n * 100 + d.n * 10 + e.n + 1 AS event_id FROM digits a CROSS JOIN digits b CROSS JOIN digits c CROSS JOIN digits d CROSS JOIN digits e) AS seq

INSERT IGNORE INTO narrow_events (event_id, account_id, narrow_group_key, payload, amount, event_date) SELECT seq.event_id, MOD(seq.event_id, 10000) + 1, CASE WHEN MOD(seq.event_id, 5) = 0 THEN 'hot_group' ELSE CONCAT('grp_', LPAD(MOD(seq.event_id, 999), 6, '0')) END, CONCAT('payload_', LPAD(seq.event_id, 6, '0')), MOD(seq.event_id, 1000) / 10.0, DATE_ADD('2024-01-01', INTERVAL MOD(seq.event_id, 365) DAY) FROM (SELECT a.n * 10000 + b.n * 1000 + c.n * 100 + d.n * 10 + e.n + 1 AS event_id FROM digits a CROSS JOIN digits b CROSS JOIN digits c CROSS JOIN digits d CROSS JOIN digits e) AS seq

tables.name: digits
tables.purpose: Deterministic helper table for bounded synthetic data generation
tables.distribution_notes: Uniform digits 0-9 used to build larger row sets without recursion.

tables.name: accounts
tables.purpose: Lookup table for many-to-one joins and modest selectivity filtering
tables.distribution_notes: Approximately 80% active, 20% inactive; segment values are uniform; account_id is unique and referenced by both fact tables.

tables.name: wide_events
tables.purpose: Mechanism-driving fact table with a wide grouped key and TEXT payload to force on-disk internal temp tables
tables.distribution_notes: 20% hot-group skew, remaining keys spread across many distinct values; wide_group_key is 700 bytes; payload is TEXT and large enough to make internal temp tables row-heavy; account_id is many-to-one to accounts; event_date is evenly distributed across the year.

tables.name: narrow_events
tables.purpose: Control fact table with the same cardinality and skew but narrower rows to compare against the wide-text case
tables.distribution_notes: Matches wide_events cardinality, join pattern, and skew, but uses short group keys and short payloads so the row shape is much friendlier to in-memory temp tables.

value_skew.wide_events.wide_group_key: hot_group appears in about 20% of rows; other groups are spread across many distinct 700-byte values
value_skew.narrow_events.narrow_group_key: same skew shape as wide_events, but with short key values

calibration_queries.sql: SELECT e.wide_group_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(e.amount) AS total_amount FROM wide_events e JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id WHERE a.active = 1 AND e.event_date >= '2024-10-01' GROUP BY e.wide_group_key ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 25
calibration_queries.objective: Verify that the wide grouped-key workload preserves the join-and-aggregate shape that should pressure internal temporary tables.
expected_evidence: The plan shows a join from the fact table to the lookup table.
The plan includes a grouped aggregation and a final ordering step.
The wide grouped key is visible in the plan shape and is not reduced to a trivial point lookup.

calibration_queries.sql: SELECT e.narrow_group_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(e.amount) AS total_amount FROM narrow_events e JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id WHERE a.active = 1 AND e.event_date >= '2024-10-01' GROUP BY e.narrow_group_key ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 25
calibration_queries.objective: Provide a control query with the same logical pattern but narrower rows, so the reproduction can contrast width-driven temp-table behavior.
expected_evidence: The plan has the same join-and-aggregate structure as the wide query.
The narrow grouped-key control makes the row-shape difference explicit.
The control preserves cardinality and selectivity while removing the wide/TEXT pressure.
